name: Executive order of June 27, 1879 setting apart a reservation on the James River for Drifting Goose's band of Yanktonai
nations: Hunkpati band of the Ihanktonwanna (Yanktonai), today within the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe
promises: This was an executive order, not a treaty. The President set apart Townships 119, 120 and 121 North, Range 63 West, in Dakota Territory as a reserve for Drifting Goose's band of Yanktonai Sioux (Royce area 613).
landTaken: None by this order: it set land apart. Royce records it was revoked by executive order of July 13, 1880.
today: The South Dakota State Archives describes it as a 65,000-acre reservation along the James River and that in 1880 Drifting Goose and his people gave it up and settled at Crow Creek Agency. The revocation is a separate record (cession-1880-07-13-sioux-drifting-goose-s-band).

sources.title: Charles C. Royce, Indian Land Cessions in the United States (18th Annual Report of the Bureau of American Ethnology, 1899), schedule p. 896, executive order of June 27, 1879
Charles C. Royce, Indian Land Cessions in the United States (18th Annual Report of the Bureau of American Ethnology, 1899), schedule p. 897, remark and area 613
Crow Creek Agency, Indian Archives Project guide

openQuestions: No court or Commission finding about the Drifting Goose reservation was located. The Yankton Sioux title found in Docket 332-C stops at Snake Creek on the James River, and the Commission dismissed the Yanktonai intervention there; whether this township block lies in any adjudicated claim area was not plotted.
The Crow Creek Sioux Tribe's own account of Drifting Goose and the James River reservation was not located on a tribal site.
The order was read only in Royce's summary.

Audit 2026-11-08: Royce pp. 896-897 and the South Dakota State Archives guide reopened. The archives say "a 65,000-acre reservation", not "about"; wording corrected. Docket 332-C interlocutory order (OSU 1307) reread: the Yankton line runs down Snake Creek to the James River and the Yanktonai intervention was dismissed. ICC full-text searches for Drifting Goose and Hunkpati return nothing about this reserve.
